description: This source file defines an extension for the String class in Swift, adding a computed property 'nonEmpty' that returns an optional String representing the trimmed version of the original String if it is not empty, or nil if it is empty after trimming whitespace and newlines.

methods.name: nonEmpty
methods.description: A computed property that returns an optional String which is non-nil if the String contains non-whitespace characters after trimming, otherwise nil.
